$comment: ADAAAA-6028 labeled grounding eval set (plan G). Each sample carries a machine-checkable ground truth (isGoal) so the grounding gate's G1 precision / G2 recall / G3 reject-count can be scored. Samples are the real soccer clips already labeled and driven on livepeer-ai-x99 in the INC-5 / VOD-EVAL-PASS1 runs (goal / near_goal = actual goals; off_target / warm_up / lull / replay = non-goals). A single-video eval (the board-flagged run ced2ea19) uses the same shape: supply its known goal timestamps as extra samples with isGoal=true and non-event timestamps with isGoal=false.
boardRuling: Corrected 2026-09-30 by board (ADAAAA-6079 comment 0b80c0b7): soc-goal-01 is a tough/ambiguous shot-on-goal (strange angle, ends right after goal) and soc-goal-02 is NOT a goal (players dribbling at mid-field). Both were mislabeled isGoal=true from the ced2ea19 board-flagged run; the grounding analyzer correctly declined to surface either. Corrected to isGoal=false so G1/G2 are scored against true labels.
